item.title: Nakatanidou: Nara's High-Speed Mochi Pounding — Guide
item.description: Nakatanidou, a small mochi shop near Sarusawa Pond in central Nara, has become one of the city’s most popular attractions thanks to its jaw-dropping high-speed mochi pounding (kosokumochitsuki). Several times a day, its artisans perform the traditional mochitsuki with breathtaking rhythm and speed — one wielding the heavy wooden mallet in a blur of strikes, the other flipping the sticky rice by hand between blows, the crowd counting along in astonishment.
